title: Korea sees rise in couples with older wives
summary: Click here for more articles by Kormedi.com. Marriages between younger Korean men and older Korean women accounted for just over 20 percent of first marriages last year, meaning roughly 1 in 5 couples consisted of a wife who was older than the husband. The share of couples with an older husband, meanwhile, continues to decline annually. Over the past 15 years, it fell by 6.1 percentage points, while the proportion of couples with an older wife rose by 5.3 percentage points. Older wives are even more common among remarried couples. The figures raise a question: Has age become less important to Koreans when considering marriage?
